outcome: Sensitivity of FPG measurement for diagnosing HIP
Rates of true negative, false positive, true positive, and false negative cases
cohort: 4245 women who had OGTT between 22 and 30 weeks of gestation at a university hospital between 2012 and 2016
finding: Considering a history of HIP and measuring FPG first can avoid more than 80% of OGTTs and identify women with the highest risk of adverse HIP-related events.
